info.title: Dev.Cli
info.description:
Command-line interface for scaffolding, workspace management, and developer
      tooling

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Dev CLI - Developer toolkit for scaffolding and workspace management

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: version
commands.description: Display the CLI version

commands.name: info
commands.description: Display information about the current project

commands.name: accelerator
commands.description: Manage accelerator lifecycle (upgrade, sync, etc.)

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Upgrade the project to a newer version of the accelerator

options.name: --upstream
options.description: The URL of the accelerator repository

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: The version (tag) to upgrade to (e.g., v1.1.1)

commands.name: archetype
commands.description: Manage scaffolding archetypes

commands.name: new
commands.description: Generate code from an archetype. Additional parameters can be passed as --ParamName value based on the archetype definition.

options.name: --project
options.description: Target project (overrides archetype default)

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Namespace or subdirectory path for generated files

options.name: --schema
options.description: Path to a JSON file for schema inference

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview what would be generated without making changes [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed output [default: False]

arguments.name: ARCHETYPE
arguments.description: The name of the archetype to use (e.g., 'web-api-feature', 'function-feature')

commands.name: interactive
commands.description: Create from an archetype using interactive prompts

arguments.name: ARCHETYPE
arguments.description: The name of the archetype to use (optional, will prompt if not provided)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all discovered archetypes

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show additional details including search paths [default: False]

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show detailed information about an archetype

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The name of the archetype to display information for

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate an archetype definition

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to the archetype directory or archetype.json file

commands.name: init
commands.description: Bootstrap or refresh the .dev/ workspace structure in the current repository

commands.name: spec
commands.description: Manage specification primitives and compilation

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile specification primitives by creating links (hard links/junctions) to target directories (.github/, .claude/, .agents/, .codex/)

options.name: --target
options.description: Target platform [default: All]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview changes without writing files [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed operations [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress non-error output [default: False]

options.name: --repair
options.description: Repair broken links (used by git hooks) [default: False]

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Model Context Protocol server for IDE integration

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start the MCP server with stdio transport

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Manage LLM/agent artifact packs

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install a pack from the source repository

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The name of the pack to install

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update one or all installed packs

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The name of the pack to update (omit to update all installed packs)

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove an installed pack from the workspace

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The name of the pack to remove

commands.name: list
commands.description: List available packs from the source repository

commands.name: token
commands.description: Manage token usage attribution and billing

commands.name: login
commands.description: Authenticate with Entra ID to configure the control plane

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize token usage configurations, mTLS certificates, environment variables, and hooks

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without making changes [default: False]

options.name: --otel-endpoint
options.description: HTTPS endpoint for OpenTelemetry metrics export

options.name: --mapping-endpoint
options.description: HTTPS endpoint for repository attribution events

options.name: --ca-enrollment-endpoint
options.description: HTTPS endpoint for mTLS certificate enrollment

options.name: --entra-client-id
options.description: Entra ID public client application ID

options.name: --entra-tenant-id
options.description: Entra ID tenant ID

options.name: --entra-scope
options.description: Delegated Entra ID scope for gateway/API writes

commands.name: status
commands.description: Display current configuration, mTLS certificate, env var, and hook status

commands.name: attribute
commands.description: Resolve repository -> customer and POST attribution metadata (hook callback)

options.name: --tool
options.description: The identifier of the AI tool triggering the hook

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove token billing configurations, environment variables, and hooks
